references.text: The same principle of a seven-day purification period applies to men with discharge, showing the parallel between purity laws for both genders.
Describes the normal menstrual impurity lasting seven days and forms the basis for understanding irregular bleeding in verses 25–28.
The immediate context describing the condition of irregular bleeding that verse 28 concludes with a purification regulation.
Similar purity laws for women after childbirth, with seven days of impurity followed by a period of purification.
A seven-day waiting period as part of the cleansing process for leprosy, illustrating the consistent pattern of seven days before full purity.
The woman who had been bleeding for twelve years was healed by Jesus, demonstrating the Messiah's power over the condition addressed in Leviticus 15:25–28.
